units.source_text: 附记：这篇小说本来计划写成现在的三四倍长。

en.t: Note: This story was originally planned to be three or four times as long as it is now.

units.source_text: 这次所发表的内容，和《大导寺信辅的前半生》的题目自然不相符合，主要因为没有其他名称可以替代，不得不沿用这个题目。

en.t: The content published this time naturally does not quite match the title The First Half of Daidoji Shinsuke's Life, but mainly because there was no other name to use instead, I had no choice but to keep this title.

units.source_text: 如果能够把这篇小说当做《大导寺信辅的前半生》里面的一篇，那就再好不过了。

en.t: If this story can be regarded as one piece within The First Half of Daidoji Shinsuke's Life, that would be best of all.
